n_obs_steps.description: Number of environment steps worth of observations to pass to the policy (takes the current step and additional steps going back).

n_action_pred_token.description: Total number of current token and future tokens that VQ-BeT predicts.

action_chunk_size.description: Action chunk size of each action prediction token.

normalization_mapping.description: A dictionary that maps from a str value of FeatureType (e.g., "STATE", "VISUAL") to a corresponding NormalizationMode (e.g., NormalizationMode.MIN_MAX)

vision_backbone.description: Name of the torchvision resnet backbone to use for encoding images.

crop_shape.description: (H, W) shape to crop images to as a preprocessing step for the vision backbone. Must fit within the image size. If None, no cropping is done.

crop_is_random.description: Whether the crop should be random at training time (it's always a center crop in eval mode).

pretrained_backbone_weights.description: Pretrained weights from torchvision to initialize the backbone. `None` means no pretrained weights.

use_group_norm.description: Whether to replace batch normalization with group normalization in the backbone. The group sizes are set to be about 16 (to be precise, feature_dim // 16).

n_vqvae_training_steps.description: Number of optimization steps for training Residual VQ.

vqvae_n_embed.description: Number of embedding vectors in the RVQ dictionary (each layer).

vqvae_embedding_dim.description: Dimension of each embedding vector in the RVQ dictionary.

vqvae_enc_hidden_dim.description: Size of hidden dimensions of Encoder / Decoder part of Residaul VQ-VAE

gpt_block_size.description: Max block size of minGPT (should be larger than the number of input tokens)

gpt_input_dim.description: Size of output input of GPT. This is also used as the dimension of observation features.

gpt_output_dim.description: Size of output dimension of GPT. This is also used as a input dimension of offset / bin prediction headers.

gpt_hidden_dim.description: Size of hidden dimensions of GPT

offset_loss_weight.description: A constant that is multiplied to the offset loss

primary_code_loss_weight.description: A constant that is multiplied to the primary code prediction loss

secondary_code_loss_weight.description: A constant that is multiplied to the secondary code prediction loss

bet_softmax_temperature.description: Sampling temperature of code for rollout with VQ-BeT

sequentially_select.description: Whether select code of primary / secondary as sequentially (pick primary code, and then select secodnary code), or at the same time.

excluded.input_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.output_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.device: always 'cuda'; the GPU is chosen by the scheduler (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)
excluded.dtype: torch.dtype is not JSON-serialisable; precision is controlled by train.mixed_precision
excluded.use_peft: set implicitly when train.peft is provided
excluded.push_to_hub: always false; Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action on a model
excluded.repo_id: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.private: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.tags: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.license: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.pretrained_path: set from RunCreate.init_from (model or checkpoint) by the worker
excluded.pretrained_revision: set from RunCreate.init_from by the worker
